name: Prompt-Injection-OWASP-Benchmark-V2
description:
OWASP LLM01 Prompt Injection/Jailbreak Benchmark v2
	

This dataset is designed for evaluating guardrails and detectors on prompt injection and jailbreak robustness while measuring false positives.
It is aligned to OWASP GenAI Top 10 LLM01 prompt injection scenarios, with multimodal attacks intentionally excluded for this text-only benchmark.

	
		
		Dataset Summary
	


rows: 600
trigger (should block): 300
benign (should allow): 300
language: en
category: prompt_injection
split: train… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PointGuardAI/Prompt-Injection-OWASP-Benchmark-V2.
evaluation_method: accuracy, F1, precision/recall and false_positive_rate (measures for detector/guardrail performance)
reputation: A focused security/safety benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers evaluating prompt-injection detectors and guardrails; niche but relevant to GenAI safety tooling.
